requirements_summary: Primary workload: in-app assistant (chat) + document search + reranking for suggestion UX.
Latency target: P50 < 200ms, P95 < 600ms for chat messages (end-to-end).
Throughput: sustained ~40-60 rps at peak burst (30min windows) across US region.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit economics are clear.
Model preferences: community open models acceptable; want Redwood-verified performance profiles + fallback to smaller models during incidents.
Routing/fallback: need policy to route traffic to lower-cost model variants automatically when Dedicated capacity constrained.
Data isolation: must run in VPC with customer-managed networking; no customer data in multi-tenant storage.
Compliance: SOC2 Type II necessary; ISO27001 nice-to-have; DPA with EU data residency clause for EU customers.
poc_summary: Hosted API POC (4 weeks): connected via SDK to stage app, ~5k daily active users during test window.
Observed latencies: median token latency ~120ms p50, request-level p95 ~540ms (some spikes during batching window).
Quality: model responses adequate for first-pass UX; reranker improved CTR on suggested articles by ~18% in A/B.
Costs: Hosted run-rate projected ~$7k/mo at current volume; estimated Dedicated break-even at committed $180k/yr for baseline throughput.
Open technical ask: KV cache warmup strategy for cold-starts and expected memory footprint for 8k context models.
